praise: The best line in your writing is the one about her always sleeping in your bed. That is a proper clue - it fits one person and not everybody - and choosing it was your own doing. You also spelled journey, stomach and believe right, which are three of the trickiest words on tonight's list.

essay.summary: Four sentences, every one of them still about the same person - you never wandered off into something else halfway through. The detail about your bed is the one doing the most work; the rest are a little softer.

fixes.why: it is some + times, and some keeps its e

fixes.was: very silly somtimes a little crazy and very fun to play with
fixes.should: very silly, sometimes a little crazy, and very fun to play with
fixes.why: when you list three things about someone, a comma goes between them

fixes.was: I am mostly always with her
fixes.should: I am almost always with her
fixes.why: mostly and always pull against each other - almost always is the one you mean

essay.next: Add one clue that could only ever be her: something she says, or something she does with her hands. Right now the clues fit a lot of people, and a riddle is best when there is exactly one answer.

focus: quiet: the q and the u travel together - q-u-i-e-t, like queen and quick
usually is usual + ly, so the u in usual has to stay in
